questions.question: What did the LORD say He was planning against the nation whose people plotted evil and seized fields and houses?

answers.text: A warning they are free to ignore
A short trial they can wait out

questions.question: The LORD said the people who seized houses also drove the women of His people out of their pleasant homes. True or false?
The LORD promised to gather the remnant of Israel together. Like which animals in a pen would He bring them?
When the gathered remnant of Israel breaks through the gate and goes out, who passes through before them as leader?
